title: Chicken Massaman (Batch)
subtitle: 4-serving meal prep. 10 min prep, 50 min simmer.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Buy the 1kg trays at Tops or Makro. Thigh holds up to a 50-min simmer; breast turns to sawdust.
Mae Ploy (yellow tub, 50g sachet equivalent) or Maesri (can). Mae Ploy is fuller, Maesri is milder.
Aroy-D 100% coconut cream in the UHT pouch — better than the cans. Skim the thick top off if using a can.
ingredients.note: Cream, not milk — for the paste to crack.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: Hom-mali (Thai waxy) holds shape. Sweet potato also works and adds fibre.

ingredients.note: Oil cap per serving. Only used if coconut cream doesn't crack on its own.

ingredients.thai_market_tip: The block kind in the baking aisle. Coconut palm sugar works too. Shave with a knife.
Cock brand tamarind concentrate, dark sticky jar. Brings the sourness that defines massaman.

ingredients.note: Massaman is the most aromatic Thai curry. Cinnamon + bay = the warm-spice layer.
Stir in at the end. Adds 50 kcal / 3g protein / 4g fat per serving.

substitutions.note: Traditional massaman is beef. Simmer time goes to 90 min — cut chunks larger.
Use 150ml light coconut milk instead. Thinner sauce, less rich, ~150 kcal lighter.
Sweeter, more fibre. Cuts the heat differently — try it once.

steps.text: Heavy pot, medium-high. Add coconut cream, simmer 4 min until the oil cracks out and bubbles round the edge.
Add Massaman paste. Fry in the cracked oil 2 min until deep brick-red and fragrant. If pan goes dry, add 1 tsp oil.
Add chicken chunks. Toss to coat fully in paste. Cook 3 min until edges are sealed.
Pour in stock, fish sauce, palm sugar, tamarind, bay leaves, cinnamon. Stir. Bring to gentle simmer.
Add potato and onion wedges. Cover, simmer 35 min on low. Check at 25 — potato should be just yielding to a knife.
Uncover, simmer 5 min to reduce. Taste: should be salt-sweet-sour, in that order. Adjust with fish sauce / palm sugar / tamarind.
Off heat, stir in peanuts if using. Cool 15 min before portioning into 4 containers. Keeps 4 days fridge, 2 months freezer.

serves_with.note: 1 pack per serving. Reheats in 90 sec on workday lunches.
Quick ajad — cucumber, shallot, rice vinegar, sugar. Cuts the richness.

notes: The non-negotiable step is cracking the coconut cream first (step 1) — that's where the curry's oil base comes from and why this recipe respects the 1 tsp added-oil cap. Massaman is the slowest of the everyday Thai curries; do it Sunday afternoon, eat off it Mon–Thu. Peanuts are technically authentic but optional — they push kcal up 50 and protein won't change much. If the sauce splits when reheated, whisk in a tablespoon of hot water.
